reading.title: PAYMENTS IN LIEU OF TAXES AGREEMENT

candidates.quote: Eligible Households: Households earning at or below 60% AMI
candidates.wording: Households earning at or below 60% AMI

candidates.quote: Total Number of Units: 72
candidates.wording: Total Number of Units

candidates.quote: Number of Affordable Units: 72
candidates.wording: Number of Affordable Units

candidates.quote: Number of Market Rate Units: 0
candidates.wording: Number of Market Rate Units

candidates.quote: Annual Payment: See Definition below.
candidates.wording: Annual Payment

candidates.quote: $43,200 per year or $732 per affordable unit per year.
candidates.wording: $43,200 per year or $732 per affordable unit per year
candidates.value: $43,200 per year or $732 per affordable unit per year

candidates.quote: The payment will escalate annually by an amount equal to the Annual Rate.
candidates.wording: escalate annually by an amount equal to the Annual Rate

candidates.quote: Annual Rate (expressed as a percentage) 2% per year
candidates.wording: 2% per year

candidates.quote: Term (in years): 40 years
candidates.wording: 40 years

candidates.quote: Long Term Affordability Covenant by Owner in favor of the County of even date hereof.
candidates.wording: Long Term Affordability Covenant by Owner

candidates.quote: The Owner has or will acquire the Property located in Prince George’s County, Maryland for the purpose of constructing or rehabilitating the Project to provide housing to Eligible Households.
candidates.wording: provide housing to Eligible Households

candidates.quote: the owner of the real property agrees to (A) continue to commence or continue to maintain the real property as rental housing for lower income persons under the requirements of the governmental programs described in item (2) of this paragraph and agrees to renew any annual contributions contract or other agreement for rental subsidy or supplement or (B) enters into an agreement with the governing body of the county to allow the entire property or the portion of the property which was maintained for lower income persons to remain as housing for lower income persons for a term of at least five years; and
candidates.wording: term of at least five years

candidates.quote: the owner and the governing body of the county where the real property is located agree that the owner shall pay a negotiated amount in lieu of the applicable county property taxes.
candidates.wording: pay a negotiated amount in lieu of the applicable county property taxes
candidates.value: negotiated amount in lieu of taxes

candidates.quote: “Affordability Covenants” means the covenants executed and recorded on the Property, in a form acceptable to the County, that require the Owner and all subsequent owners of the Property to offer for rent at least the Affordable Units to Eligible Households.
candidates.wording: Owner and all subsequent owners of the Property

candidates.quote: “Affordable Units” mean those rental units in the Project that will be dedicated to the Eligible Households.
candidates.wording: rental units in the Project that will be dedicated to the Eligible Households
candidates.value: Affordable Units dedicated to Eligible Households

candidates.quote: “Affordable Unit Annual Payment” means the amount set forth in the Project Facts Section that represents the amount the Owner shall pay in lieu of taxes in accordance with this Agreement for the Affordable Units.
candidates.wording: amount the Owner shall pay in lieu of taxes

candidates.quote: For projects consisting entirely of Affordable Units, then the Annual Payment shall consist of the Affordable Unit Annual Payment.
candidates.wording: Annual Payment shall consist of the Affordable Unit Annual Payment

candidates.quote: “Eligible Households” mean the households as described in the Project Facts Section that are eligible to reside in the Project and whose initial annual income is sixty percent (60%) or less of the median income as set from time to time by the United States Department of Housing and Urban Development for Section 8 Programs in the Baltimore Metropolitan Statistical Area.
candidates.wording: initial annual income is sixty percent (60%) or less of the median income
candidates.value: 60% or less of area median income

candidates.quote: “Market Rate Units ” means those rental units in the Project that are anticipated to be unrestricted and leased at market rate.
candidates.wording: unrestricted and leased at market rate

candidates.quote: “PILOT” means the negotiated payments in lieu of taxes.
candidates.wording: negotiated payments in lieu of taxes

candidates.quote: The payments to be made by the Owner to the County, provided for herein with respect to the Project, shall be in lieu of the payment of Prince George’s County taxes on real property under the Tax-Property Article of the Annotated Code of Maryland, as amended.
candidates.wording: in lieu of the payment of Prince George’s County taxes on real property
candidates.value: payments in lieu of real property taxes

candidates.quote: During that period commencing with the Substantial Completion Date until the Termination Date, the Project shall be exempt from paying full Prince George’s County real property taxes.
candidates.wording: exempt from paying full Prince George’s County real property taxes
candidates.value: exemption from full real property taxes

candidates.quote: If the Project consist entirely of Affordable Units, then the Annual Payment shall consist of the Affordable Unit Annual Payment.
candidates.wording: Annual Payment shall consist of the Affordable Unit Annual Payment

candidates.quote: Owner agrees to maintain the Property as rental housing for lower income persons under the requirements a federal, State, or local government program and the Owner agrees to renew any annual contributions contract or other agreement for rental subsidy or supplement.
candidates.wording: rental housing for lower income persons
